# ReadingBat-content

> A ReadingBat content repository — Python, Java, and Kotlin "reading
> comprehension" coding challenges wired into the ReadingBat web framework
> via a Kotlin DSL. This repo does not implement the framework itself; it
> depends on `com.readingbat:readingbat-core` and supplies challenge source
> files plus a `Content.kt` DSL declaration that registers them.

Adding a challenge always means two things: (1) put the source file in the
appropriate language directory under the group's `packageName`, and
(2) register it in `src/main/kotlin/Content.kt` — either with an explicit
`challenge("name") { returnType = ... }` block or via an
`includeFilesWithType = "pattern*.ext" returns SomeType` glob. A file on
disk is invisible to the site until the DSL references it. Java return
types are inferred from the source; Python and Kotlin must be declared.

Current version: **1.1.0** (see [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)). Building requires
JDK 25.

## Project layout

- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): orientation for LLM-driven contributions —
  commands, content/source pairing rules, gotchas.
- [README.md](README.md): human-facing overview, DSL example, Build & Run table.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): Keep-a-Changelog history.
- [RELEASE_NOTES.md](RELEASE_NOTES.md): prose-style release summaries.
- [src/main/kotlin/Content.kt](src/main/kotlin/Content.kt): the DSL declaration
  that wires every challenge file into a language group.
- [src/main/kotlin/ContentServer.kt](src/main/kotlin/ContentServer.kt): thin
  entry point that delegates to `ReadingBatServer.start(args)`.

## Challenge sources

- [python/](python/): Python challenge source files.
- [src/main/java/jgroup/](src/main/java/jgroup/): Java challenge source files.
- [src/main/kotlin/kgroup/](src/main/kotlin/kgroup/): Kotlin challenge source files.

## Build & tooling

- [Makefile](Makefile): self-documenting (`make help`). Common targets:
  `make run`, `make build`, `make tests`, `make lint`, `make format`,
  `make uber`, `make versions`.
- [build.gradle.kts](build.gradle.kts): Gradle build with Kotlin JVM, Ktor,
  Shadow, kotlinter, detekt, and the Versions plugin.
- [gradle/libs.versions.toml](gradle/libs.versions.toml): version catalog.
  Kotlin 2.4.10, Ktor 3.5.1, readingbat-core 3.3.0, Kotest 6.2.3,
  kotlinter 5.6.0, detekt 2.0.0-alpha.5, Gradle wrapper 9.6.1, JVM toolchain 25.
- [settings.gradle.kts](settings.gradle.kts): centralized repository config
  (`RepositoriesMode.FAIL_ON_PROJECT_REPOS`).
- [gradle.properties](gradle.properties): project `group` and `version`.
- [.github/workflows/ci.yml](.github/workflows/ci.yml): GitHub Actions CI —
  runs `lintKotlin`, `detekt`, and `test` on pushes to `master` and on every
  pull request.

## Tests

- [src/test/kotlin/](src/test/kotlin/): Kotest `StringSpec` tests using
  `com.readingbat:readingbat-kotest` helpers (`testModule`, `forEachLanguage`,
  `forEachChallenge`, etc.). `ContentTests.kt` is the canonical example.

## Optional

- [Procfile](Procfile): Heroku entry point. Runs the shadow uberjar with
  `-Dagent.config=src/main/resources/application.conf`.
- [src/main/resources/application.conf](src/main/resources/application.conf):
  Ktor configuration. `watch = ["readingbat-template"]` is dev-only.
